name: LocationTracking
description: GPS ping for an active employee shift. v2: written at most every N minutes (default 5, was double 30s writes), raw points pruned after D days (default 30) leaving per-shift summaries on AttendanceRecord (see DATA-MODEL.md §4). RLS: own-only read — fixes I-001 (was world-readable employee location history).

rls_intended.read: own (user_email == current user) OR manager+ = all
